describe_repository.description: Query Siebel repository metadata for the full field list of a Business Component. Returns richer data than describe_business_object: pre/post default values, LOV picklist types, calculated field flags, join info, and fields that are valid in searchspec/sort_spec but not returned by the REST data API. Always call this when you need fields not listed by describe_business_object, before create/update to check required field defaults, or when unsure about a field name or picklist values.
